result.finding: Minimal security implementation: no authentication, no authorization, no HTTPS/TLS, no Spring Security. The application is fully open (no login required). Only basic file upload validation (MIME type, size) is implemented. Database credentials are stored as plaintext environment variables.
evidence: pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-security is NOT included as a dependency
No @EnableWebSecurity, @PreAuthorize, JWT, OAuth2, or authentication code found in source
No SSL/TLS configuration in application.properties (no server.ssl.* properties)
Database credentials in plaintext environment variables: SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD, APP_USER_PASSWORD, ORACLE_PASSWORD
No CORS, CSP, or HSTS security headers configured
CDN resources loaded over HTTPS (Bootstrap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) — client-side only
values: Transport security: HTTP only (no HTTPS/TLS configured)
Input validation: file MIME type and size checks
Credential management: plaintext environment variables (security risk)
